neighbours.label: an attributive quality adjective (certified, polished, raw, traditional) right after a possessive 'our'/'their'
fire: For three generations we have relied on our certified inspectors to check every weld.
Guests can relax in the lobby and admire our polished oak floors.
Critics praised the trio for their raw energy on stage.
During the festival we share our traditional recipes with visitors.
The roofers arrived on time, and their certified crew finished in a day.
The jeweller showed us their polished silver rings and bracelets.
The villagers still wear their traditional dress at weddings.
The juice bar is famous for our raw honey and ginger shots.
quiet: For three generations inspectors have been certified here before checking any weld.
Guests can relax in the lobby while the oak floors are being polished.
Critics praised the trio, although the vegetables at the venue were served raw.
During the festival the recipes on offer are mostly traditional.
The roofers arrived on time, and only certified crews may work on such a roof.
The jeweller polished the silver rings and bracelets for us.
The villagers hold weddings that are very traditional in style.
The juice bar is famous for honey that is sold raw with ginger.

notes: Weak pole (max 2.64) that the card flags as gate-closed (-x- echo 98% of the >0.1 band). Probes: 'our certified' 0.67, 'our polished' 0.60, 'their raw' 0.48, but also 'The emergence' 0.45 and 'uncompromising' 0.46 without a possessive; the same adjectives predicative or after 'the'/'Only' scored <0.04. The label covers only the possessive pattern; ' emergence' and 'ising' are known extra triggers not in the test. The - pole is the token ' emerging'.
